title: Anticlimax
summary: ANTICLI'MAX, noun [Gr. opposite, and climax. See Climate.] A sentence in which the ideas fall or become less important and striking at the close; opposed to climax. For example, Next comes Dalhousie,

inlines.v: ANTICLI'MAX, noun [Gr. opposite, and climax. See Climate.] A sentence in which the ideas fall or become less important and striking at the close; opposed to climax. For example, Next comes Dalhousie, the great God of war, Lieutenant Col'nel to the Earl of Mar.
